outcome: The same-minute guard now suppresses only an already persisted local structural-sound record.  A same-minute local zombie observation no longer prevents the subsequent one-shot sound callback, while an actual sound record still suppresses the replay callback.
reasoning: game::do_turn records local zombie observations in the loaded-scene prepass before it drains significant sounds.

The narrowed predicate recognizes the durable structural sound identity: typed schema version, sound sense, structural-signal producer, and the current minute.
